import json
from pathlib import Path

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

root = Path('results/final/selected')
selection_path = Path('results/training/selection.json')
selection = json.loads(selection_path.read_text())
for trial in selection['trials']:
    assert all(file_sha256(p) == h for p, h in trial['input_sha256'].items())
assert file_sha256(Path(selection['adapter'])/'adapters.safetensors') == selection['adapter_sha256']
games = {}
for game in ('dice', 'cards'):
    acquisition = root / f'acquisition_{game}.json'
    data = json.loads(acquisition.read_text())
    assert data['episodes'] == 200 and data['seeds'] == list(range(200, 400))
    assert data['provenance']['model_revision'] == selection['provenance']['model_revision']
    games[game] = {k: data[k] for k in ('episodes','wall_seconds','peak_memory_bytes')}
record = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose':'retain the frozen local candidate complete test acquisition, without computing scores'}, selection['provenance']['model_revision']),
          'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'label': selection['label'],
          'selection_file': str(selection_path), 'selection_sha256': file_sha256(selection_path),
          'adapter_sha256': selection['adapter_sha256'], 'games': games,
          'input_sha256': {str(p): file_sha256(p) for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and p.name != 'cohorts.json'},
          'interpretation':'All 200 seeds per game complete after immutable validation selection. Acquisition wall times are cumulative from process start; the cards time is total acquisition runtime, not an additional independent duration. Canonical states verified; no held-out aggregate computed. Scores await frozen newest-model selection.'}
(root/'cohorts.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print({'label':record['label'],'games':games,'scores':'sealed'})
